title: Rectified Language Flow
abstract: arXiv:2610.33811v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous-state flow and diffusion models offer a promising approach to fast, parallel language generation, but matching the generation quality of autoregressive models remains challenging. We present Rectified Language Flow (ReLF), a language model that generates text by transporting noise to token embeddings using rectified flow. ReLF combines several complementary design choices: fixed token embeddings constructed with Hellinger-SVD, self-conditioning guidance trained with cross-entropy, and regularized reflow for few-step generation. We further introduce singular logits, which combine an analytically computed term that drives commitment to a valid token embedding as noise vanishes with a bounded neural residual that learns contextual token preferences. translated_abstract: 连续状态流和扩散模型为快速、并行的语言生成提供了一种有前景的方法，但要达到自回归模型的生成质量仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了整流语言流，这是一种通过使用整流流将噪声传输到词元嵌入来生成文本的语言模型。ReLF 结合了几个互补的设计选择：使用 Hellinger-SVD 构建的固定词元嵌入、通过交叉熵训练的自条件引导，以及用于少步生成的正则化重流。我们进一步引入了奇异 logits，它将一个解析计算的项（随着噪声消失，驱动模型承诺于有效的词元嵌入）与一个学习上下文词元偏好的有界神经残差相结合。在 OpenWebText 上，仅需 64 次函数评估，ReLF 在所有三种测试的模型规模下，于匹配多样性条件下实现了比自回归基线更低的生成困惑度，同时……
tldr: ReLF 是一种基于整流流的语言模型，通过结合 Hellinger-SVD 固定词元嵌入、自条件引导、正则化重流和奇异 logits 等设计，仅需 64 次函数评估即可在匹配多样性的情况下实现比自回归基线更低的生成困惑度，实现高质量并行文本生成。
en_tdlr: ReLF is a rectified flow-based language model that combines Hellinger-SVD fixed token embeddings, self-conditioning guidance, regularized reflow, and singular logits, achieving lower generative perplexity than autoregressive baselines at matched diversity with only 64 function evaluations.
